newsitem.title: USA: Illinois House takes up school funding - paper.
newsitem.headline: Illinois House takes up school funding - paper.

text.p: The Illinois House heard from more than a dozen organizations Wednesday addressing school funding at a committee of the whole meeting in Springfield, the Chicago Sun-Times reported Thursday.

While no action was taken, House Speaker Michael Madigan, D-Chicago, said that a deal over school funding should provide money to repair school buildings and provide aid for parents in private schools, the newspaper said.
No details were available on how the state would fund school repairs, however the newspaper said school officials have asked House Democrats to support a state-backed bond program for schools.
